hero.hero_headline: I Build AI-Powered Marketing Engines That Run 24/7
hero.hero_description: I architect AI-powered marketing infrastructure - server-side tracking, automated content pipelines, multi-platform bidding agents, and real-time reporting dashboards. 10 years across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Google.

about.about_description:
I bridge performance marketing with AI automation. My work spans from implementing server-side conversion tracking infrastructure to building multi-agent AI systems that generate content, analyze campaign data, and optimize bids across platforms.

Currently Head of Marketing at Novaticom Global, I lead AI-driven initiatives and build marketing teams. Previously delivered 1819.7% ROAS for a healthcare client at LifeCare Diagnosis Center - MYR 330,289 in sales from MYR 18,150 monthly spend - across Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and Google Ads.

My edge: I write code, build AI agents, and architect martech stacks. I treat marketing as a systems problem - every process can be automated, every data point can drive a decision, every campaign can run smarter.

projects.title: Social Media AI Content Generator
projects.problem: Manual FB content planning across multiple client accounts - inconsistent posting, labor-intensive research.
projects.solution: AI agent scrapes historical FB posts, analyzes top-performing content patterns, and generates a full month of platform-optimized social posts.
projects.impact: Reduced content planning from 8+ hours/week per client to 30 minutes of review.

projects.title: VSL AI Generator
projects.problem: Crafting multiple VSL angles for ad creative testing is time-intensive.
projects.solution: AI system generates multiple video script angles and VSL variations from a single brief.
projects.impact: Reduced VSL production time from days to hours.

projects.title: Automated Social Media Scheduler
projects.problem: Manual post scheduling requires UI interaction - no automation bridge between generation and publishing.
projects.solution: Headless social media scheduler bypasses UI dependencies. AI content auto-queued, formatted, and published.
projects.impact: Zero manual intervention required after content generation.

projects.title: Multi AI Agent Ad Copies Generator
projects.problem: Creating platform-specific ad copy at scale across Meta, Google, LinkedIn, and TikTok.
projects.solution: Orchestrates multiple specialized AI agents - each handling a platform's unique copy requirements.
projects.impact: Scaled ad copy production across 4 platforms simultaneously.

projects.title: AI Agent Google Slide Report Generator
projects.problem: Monthly campaign reporting is manual - extracting data, building slides consumes days.
projects.solution: AI agent extracts campaign data from Google Sheets and auto-generates formatted Google Slide decks.

projects.title: PDF Text Extraction for RAG
projects.problem: Unstructured PDF documents contain valuable data locked in non-machine-readable formats.
projects.solution: Uses Mistral AI OCR to extract text and feed into a RAG pipeline for LLM-based knowledge retrieval.
projects.impact: Enabled AI agents to answer questions from document sources.

projects.title: AI Landing Page Content Generator
projects.problem: Creating landing page content from structured data requires manual copywriting.
projects.solution: Reads structured data from Sheets, generates optimized content through AI, syncs to CMS.
projects.impact: Structured data -> AI content -> live page pipeline automated.

projects.title: AI Product Image Generator
projects.problem: Producing product showcase images requires designers or expensive photoshoots.
projects.solution: AI agent analyzes product images and generates optimized visuals via Google Gemini.
projects.impact: Eliminated dependency on photoshoots for ad creative.

projects.title: WhatsApp AI Agent Chatbot
projects.problem: Customer inquiries after-hours - FAQ chatbots lack conversational intelligence.
projects.solution: Production-ready WhatsApp AI agent with dynamic workflows and vector store semantic search.

projects.title: Full-Stack AI SEO Blog Generator
projects.problem: Producing >5,000 word SEO content with research and clustering takes days per article.
projects.solution: End-to-end AI blogging: keyword research -> topic clustering -> metadata -> full article generation.
projects.impact: Days reduced to minutes per article.

projects.title: Google Ads Keyword Research + Segmentation
projects.problem: Manual keyword research across accounts is slow - proper grouping takes hours.
projects.solution: Multi-agent system connects to Google Ads API for campaign analysis and LLM-powered keyword segmentation.
projects.impact: Hours of analysis reduced to minutes.

projects.title: Google Ads Campaign Media Plan Generator
projects.problem: Creating RSA ad copies at scale with full ad strength compliance.
projects.solution: AI agent generates RSA ad copies based on funnel level and keyword groupings.
projects.impact: Full RSA ad strength compliance with A/B testing readiness.

projects.title: Landing Page Sections Generator
projects.problem: JSON data -> production HTML requires handoff between strategy, copy, and dev teams.
projects.solution: Multi-agent system generates structured content and production-ready HTML.
projects.impact: Bridged the gap between content strategy and development.

projects.title: Full Website Generation via Agentic Coding
projects.problem: Building landing pages from briefs requires weeks of development.
projects.solution: Agentic coding system using Claude Code CLI with MCP servers to generate complete pages from natural language.

projects.title: Interactive Agentic UI for Google Ads
projects.problem: Campaign performance data is locked inside Google Ads UI.
projects.solution: Self-built agentic UI enabling natural language queries for campaign insights.
projects.impact: Conversational access to all campaign data.

projects.title: Chiropractic WordPress Site Development
projects.problem: Building a professional chiropractic clinic website from scratch required development expertise and medical industry knowledge.
projects.solution: Full WordPress site development with custom theme, booking integration, and clinic information architecture tailored for patient conversion.
projects.impact: Complete professional web presence for chiropractic practice - live and converting.

projects.title: Chiropractic Landing Pages Optimization
projects.problem: Existing landing pages were not converting visitors to patients - poor UX and slow load times.
projects.solution: Redesigned and optimized landing pages with improved UX, faster load times, and conversion-focused layouts.
projects.impact: Improved conversion rates through optimized landing page design and performance.

projects.title: Aesthetic Service WordPress Site Development
projects.problem: Aesthetic clinic needed a professional online presence to showcase services and attract new clients.
projects.solution: Custom WordPress site with service galleries, booking integration, and brand-aligned visual design.
projects.impact: Comprehensive web presence for aesthetic service business - online booking + service showcase.

how_i_work_cards.phase_description: I start by understanding your business processes, marketing stack, pain points, and growth objectives. This maps the automation opportunity.
I design the system architecture - data flows, API integrations, trigger logic, and fallback paths. Every connection is documented.
I select and configure the right AI models, craft production-tested prompts with structured outputs, and design agent orchestration flows.
I build the automation in N8N (or custom code), wire up APIs, implement error handling, and set up monitoring.
I run the system against real data, test edge cases and failure scenarios, and validate output quality against benchmarks.
I deploy to production, configure webhooks, set up alerting, and deliver documentation your team can use.
I monitor performance, refine AI prompts based on real-world outputs, and ship iterative improvements.
